queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM player_college
  GROUP BY college_id
),
t AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt
  FROM c
)
SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count,
       AVG(CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_cnt) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(c.cnt - t.avg_cnt) AS avg_diff
FROM c, t
WHERE c.cnt > t.avg_cnt;
SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id;
SELECT college_id,
       COUNT(*) AS player_count,
       AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS avg_count,
       SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_count
FROM player_college
WHERE college_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY college_id;
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college) AS total,
  (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (
     SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS cnt
     FROM player_college
     WHERE college_id IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY college_id
  )) AS average;
SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS num_players
FROM player_college
GROUP BY college_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TOTAL', COUNT(DISTINCT player_id)
FROM player_college;
